changelog: CyberFoil 1.5.0
External themes
Customize colors, backgrounds, banners, and UI icons using external JSON files.
Keep multiple themes in `switch/CyberFoil/theme/` and choose one in **Settings > System > Theme**.
Apply themes without restarting. An animated spinner and progress bar show the transition while layouts are recreated.
Use the built-in **Default** option to restore the standard appearance.
Six example palettes are included: Midnight Blue, OLED Mint, Forest Green, Violet Dusk, Ember Amber, and Crimson Night.
Selection highlights stay behind main-menu icons and Remote cover art. Settings rows and section tabs respect theme colors.
Custom offline database packs
Optional `custom_titles.pack` and `custom_icons.pack` supplement the default offline database. Custom entries take priority for matching title IDs.
Create packs from title JSON and your own images using `tools/create_custom_packs.py` in the source repository.
Icons use the same processing as Offline-DB-Maker: 128×128 with Lanczos, EXIF orientation handling, white-background alpha compositing, and WebP at quality 80, method 6.
Offline database updates preserve custom packs.
USB drive browsing
Hide dot files and folders by default, including macOS `._` sidecar files.
Hide common Windows metadata names, including `$RECYCLE.BIN` and `System Volume Information`.
Press **−** or tap **Show hidden / Hide hidden** to toggle visibility. The preference is saved and is also available in General settings.
Hidden entries are excluded from Select All and new install selections; empty-folder controls handle missing selections safely.
Remote discovery and installation controls
Discover AeroFoil servers on the LAN from Remote settings.
